feedback.issue: None identified - All HIGH vulnerabilities eliminated
feedback.suggestion: Excellent security hardening. All 4 HIGH vulnerabilities from Iteration 1 successfully eliminated.

feedback.issue: Variable Quoting: 27 potentially unquoted variables in coordinator-entrypoint.sh (threshold: <5)
feedback.suggestion: Wrap all variable expansions in double quotes. Example: Change 'cd $PROJECT_ROOT' to 'cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"'. Focus on variables in error messages, paths, and command arguments. Priority variables: PROJECT_ROOT, AGENT_FILE, CFN_SUCCESS_CRITERIA, RESOLVED_PATH, CONTEXT_FILE.

feedback.issue: Insecure Temp File Creation: Using '/tmp/task-context-${TASK_ID}.json' instead of mktemp
feedback.suggestion: Replace line 99 with: CONTEXT_FILE="$(mktemp /tmp/task-context-XXXXXX.json)" || { echo "Failed to create temp file"; exit 1; }. This prevents race conditions and predictable temp file names.

feedback.issue: Container Auto-Remove: AutoRemove flag not found in orchestrate.sh (resource leak potential)
feedback.suggestion: Add 'AutoRemove: true' to Docker container configuration in orchestrate.sh or ensure manual cleanup. This prevents container accumulation over time. Low priority as manual cleanup exists.
